name: Client service level report
summary: At the end of each reporting period, the service delivery manager gets the report a client contract calls for: every service level measured from your own records, each miss explained by those records, the credits the contract states listed for a person to confirm, and the open questions. Nothing is sent.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of the work, and its own rules for prepared work: the contract's service levels set out once by a person as the only authority, fixed inputs that stop on a mismatch, every result shown with its working, every gap written as a question, and a person who confirms exclusions and credits and sends the report.
